scope: ND (weight_nz_mode=0, INT8 format 2) versus NZ (mode 1, format 29) on real captured MLP inputs and the candidate service

local_microbench.note: NZ/ND ratio >1 means ND faster; ND is slower in the isolated full MLP chain at nearly every shape.

service_subset.scope: 63 OpenDecisions requests concentrated on the short-shape regression bins; TP2/seqs1/eager/16384/16 images/cache off/GDN decision prefill

accuracy.denominator: fixed 400-sample set; failures count as incorrect

throughput.basis: successful decisions / wall clock, client concurrency 1

nd_erqa.warmup: full 400-sample warmup immediately before the measured 400-sample window

verdict: ND fixes the short-shape end-to-end regression and recovers OD throughput above BF16, but the W8A8 quality remains below BF16. Keep BF16 as the submission default; ND is the performance candidate.
